_comment: Demo REST/API source for end-to-end validation of the schema-driven rest_api path. Uses jsonplaceholder (public, no auth, stable, returns one object per id) so the whole chain — smart-app /run_query -> MCP catalogue._run_rest -> rest_connector -> live API -> typed rows -> panel — can be proven without a real bureau contract. Register this in the dept-MCP's dept_sources (or sources.json), then follow docs/decision-app-test-plan.md §7b 'Live E2E'.
